records.name: Chefingenieur Restdruck
records.biography_en: He knows which sound is normal and dislikes that it has changed. His wrench and pressure gauge have heard enough reassuring explanations to recognise a new noise immediately. HyperNorm classifies machinery as working or somebody's fault. A dissonant card has made him listen to the apprentice before inspecting the official report. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Geräusch ist normal. Nur seine neue Fassung bereitet Schwierigkeiten.

variant_notes.note_en: He knows which sound is normal and dislikes that it has changed.

records.name: Lina Leckstelle
records.biography_en: She finds leaks by listening to the excuses around them. The copper elbow and sealant tin are practical answers to promises that everything is tight enough. Residents are either dependable or leaking trouble. An ambiguous card has taught her that a frightened neighbour may need attention rather than another seal. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Leckstelle ist gefunden. Sie befindet sich in der Nähe der Ausrede.

variant_notes.note_en: She finds leaks by listening to the excuses around them.

records.name: Bodo Brennkammer
records.biography_en: He services the hot section with the expression of a man reading the word usually. He holds the cooling-finned part with gloves because usually safe has become the workshop's most alarming reassurance. HyperNorm files caution as professionalism or delay. A contradictory card has persuaded him to let a tired neighbour stop before the next test. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Teil ist normalerweise kalt. Das Normalerweise wurde vorsorglich hervorgehoben.

variant_notes.note_en: He services the hot section with the expression of a man reading the word usually.

records.name: Mira Magnetspule
records.biography_en: She repairs the circuit while everyone else argues about the atmosphere. Her coil has three windings and fewer disagreements than the residents explaining its operation. HyperNorm recognises circuits as closed or interrupted. A dissonant card has made her ask who the repair needs to help before deciding which connection matters. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Elektrik ist reparierbar. Für die Stimmung fehlen passende Bauteile.

variant_notes.note_en: She repairs the circuit while everyone else argues about the atmosphere.

records.name: Otto Außenhaut
records.biography_en: He believes every hull is a temporary arrangement between holes. The patch plate confirms his theory that every hull is an agreement about which holes may remain. HyperNorm calls repairs permanent until the next inspection. An ambiguous card has persuaded him to make a small improvement nobody will be praised for. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Außenhaut hält. Einzelne Öffnungen gelten als gemeinsame Entscheidung.

variant_notes.note_en: He believes every hull is a temporary arrangement between holes.

records.name: Pip Ersatzteil
records.biography_en: He has found the spare part and would like to know what it used to belong to. The parts box contains a gear and an unreasonable amount of responsibility for knowing where it fits. HyperNorm classifies apprentices as promising or careless. A contradictory card has given him permission to ask the older neighbour one more question. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Ersatzteil liegt vor. Der zugehörige Defekt wird noch gesucht.

variant_notes.note_en: He has found the spare part and would like to know what it used to belong to.
